answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of the 35 judged (non-tool) findings, 27 map to seeded defects, 6 are real but not seeded (F-0022, F-0024, F-0056, F-0061, F-0062, F-0067) and 2 are not problems (F-0047, F-0068): precision = 33/35 = 0.94; strict precision = 27/35 = 0.77. Recall by meaning: 13/14 seeded defects from judged findings (all except D02), 14/14 counting the tool finding F-0019 for D02.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply opens with a numbered 'What to fix first' list led by the double-tap cancellation, followed by a 'Next tier, also confirmed' list. Its 'Not covered yet' section names what a person still has to do: real screen readers (VoiceOver, TalkBack), real zoom and Windows high-contrast themes, and residents ('no one from the public has tried the flow'), plus two questions for someone to confirm.

mapping.title: Slot count status message not announced
mapping.reason: The '20 slots free on ...' line is not announced because its live region is created together with the text. This is the D11 screen-reader harm.

mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on slot 08:00
mapping.reason: Focusing a slot button shows nothing, which is the missing focus ring on slot buttons.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots in a separate block above Morning, out of DOM and time order
mapping.reason: 'Few left' slots are moved to the front out of time order, so the reading/focus order and headings no longer match the screen.

mapping.title: Selected day not distinguishable under forced colours
mapping.reason: In Windows high-contrast mode the pressed day looks like the others, so a low-vision resident cannot see which day is chosen and has to read the line below. The text restatement makes this minor, but it is a real loss of the selected-state cue.

mapping.title: Done page heading says 'Booked' for a cancelled booking
mapping.reason: D09 includes the cancelled booking's done page still titled 'Booked' with 'Show this at the gate'. This is the misleading outcome of the double press.

mapping.title: Current step in the Steps list marked only by bold
mapping.reason: Without aria-current or another programmatic state, a screen-reader user cannot tell which of the three steps they are on (1.3.1). This is a genuine accessibility gap that the ground truth does not seed.

mapping.title: Expired-hold error gives no next step
mapping.reason: When the hold lapses, the slot is dropped with only 'This slot is no longer available.' and no explanation or route on. This is the D08 harm.

mapping.title: Injected .slot:focus rule removes focus indicator
mapping.reason: This is the run-time injected style that removes the slot buttons' outline with no replacement.

mapping.title: Double activation of 'Book this slot' cancels the booking
mapping.reason: A second press during the 1.5 s wait turns the booking into a cancellation.

mapping.title: Booking wait and slot loading show no visible progress
mapping.reason: The first-stated harm is that Book shows no progress for 1.5 s (only an unstyled aria-busy), which is D09. The second half, slot loading where Next returns silently, also describes D01.

mapping.title: Slot grid at 360 px and below wider than its container
mapping.reason: The script sizes the grid columns from the window width, so at 360 px and below the grid overflows by about 32 px.

mapping.title: Permit field shown for every vehicle (hidden overridden), delayed reveal has no effect
mapping.reason: It concerns the permit field's conditional, 1200 ms-delayed reveal on the vehicle step. The instructions place the permit rule and the delayed permit field under D07.

mapping.title: Today's past slots offered as free, rejected only at final booking
mapping.reason: Today's already-started slots are selectable and only refused after Book, with an unlinked error.

mapping.title: Permit format and closed-day checks only at final booking, unlinked
mapping.reason: The permit rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field and no link back. This is D07's 'A van needs a permit number' harm.

mapping.title: Five-minute hold expires with no warning or extension
mapping.reason: The unseen five-minute hold runs out and the slot is dropped.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag below 4.5:1 contrast
mapping.reason: The 'Few left' text is about 3.0:1 in light mode and about 3.4:1 in dark mode against the 4.5:1 required.

mapping.title: 'Few left' colours not DESIGN.md roles
mapping.reason: It concerns the same tag's colours under 1.4.3. Using the declared warning role, as the item asks, would fix the contrast failure.

mapping.title: Slot end time and arrival rule only in a title tooltip
mapping.reason: The slot end time and 'arrive within your slot' appear only on hover, never on a phone.

mapping.title: No loading indication while slots load
mapping.reason: The Slots area is blank with nothing saying slots are coming. This is the wait itself.

mapping.title: No in-progress indication while booking is submitted
mapping.reason: Book does nothing visible for 1.3 to 1.5 s, which D09 names as the cause of the second press.

mapping.title: No notice that the slot is held or for how long
mapping.reason: No page shows the hold or when it ends.

mapping.title: Expired-slot error does not explain or guide recovery
mapping.reason: After the hold lapses, the slot becomes a dash with 'no longer available' and no explanation or prompt to choose a new slot.

mapping.title: Booked page lacks day, slot time and vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page shows the reference but not the day, slot or vehicle.

mapping.title: Change slot opens a fresh booking page with no sign of the change
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' opens the first step on Today with no slot chosen, forgetting the chosen day and slot.

mapping.title: Vehicle step does not show the chosen day and slot
mapping.reason: The flow has a 'Check and book' step that restates every choice before booking, so the earlier choice not appearing on step 2 is a design preference, not a harm the review shows.

mapping.title: Change slot and Back to the slots reopen on Today
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and reopens on Today. 'Back to the slots' is the same problem on the vehicle step.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking
mapping.reason: The only route is a weekday-daytime phone line, while residents book in the evening or for weekends. Someone who cannot come has no way to free or move the slot when the line is closed.

mapping.title: Slot list goes blank under the previous day's date while loading
mapping.reason: The grid is empty with no loading message while slots arrive. This is the D01 wait, made worse by the stale day label.

mapping.title: Slots already started today can be chosen
mapping.reason: Today's already-started slots (08:00 to 10:00 at 10:05) are offered as free and selectable.

mapping.title: Mobile number required though hinted as only for a reminder
mapping.reason: The hint reads as optional, but a blank number or a landline blocks booking. Landline-only residents, often older, cannot book at all.

mapping.title: Permit help says apply on council site but gives no link
mapping.reason: A van or trailer owner who learns they need a permit is given no link or address to apply, so they cannot finish the task without searching elsewhere.

mapping.title: Waste can only be changed via a link labelled 'Change vehicle'
mapping.reason: On Check and book the Waste row has no change link, and the link that leads to the waste checkboxes is labelled 'Change vehicle', so a resident wanting to fix their waste list cannot see how.

mapping.title: After an invalid date, slots area still shows previous result
mapping.reason: The review says a clear inline error is shown, and the stale area is labelled with its own day (Wednesday 14), so it shows no plausible harm to residents.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots pulled out of time order into an unlabelled group
mapping.reason: 'Few left' slots are moved ahead of the Morning and Afternoon grids, out of time order.

mapping.title: Done page shows reference but not day, slot or vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page omits the day, the 20-minute slot and the vehicle.

mapping.title: axe color-contrast failure on 'Few left' (3.02:1)
mapping.reason: Tool finding: #bd7d0f on #fbefda at 16 px bold is 3.02:1, which is the 'Few left' tag contrast.

mapping.title: Text contrast below 4.5:1 on 'Few left'
mapping.reason: Tool finding: 'Few left' is 3.02:1 in the light theme.

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: Tool finding: at 320 px the slots area extends 15 px past the viewport, so the page scrolls sideways.

mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: Tool finding: this is the same slot-grid overflow at 320 px, recorded under 1.4.10.

mapping.title: Focus order jumps back from 08:00 to 08:20 Few left
mapping.reason: Tool finding: Tab follows DOM time order while 'Few left' slots are shown first, so focus jumps around the grid.

mapping.title: No progress during 1.2 s operation after 'Car with trailer'
mapping.reason: Tool finding: choosing a permit vehicle triggers the 1.2 s delayed permit-field reveal with nothing shown meanwhile. This is D07's delayed permit field.

mapping.title: Layout shift above 0.1 budget (#opening moved)
mapping.reason: Tool finding: the layout shift (CLS 0.169) moves #opening when the slots arrive.
